description: Map free-text gear lines onto the public Soundcheck inventory catalog. Returns mapped[] (input, inventory_id, name, category, confidence) and unmapped[] (input + suggestions). Deterministic alias matching (e.g. SM58 → mic_shure_sm58). Does not read or write organization inventory stock. search_inventory browses the taxonomy.

lines.description: gear lines to normalize (e.g. ["SM58", "2x passive DI", "moving head"]). Empty/whitespace lines are skipped. Max 64 lines, 200 chars each.

name: normalize_inventory

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Normalize inventory lines
